section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Torque Converter, Electrical Parts)
ocr_text:
AT-104     AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups
                                    (Torque Converter, Electrical Parts)

2.  TEST ONE-WAY CLUTCH

The clutch should lock when turned counterclockwise, and should rotate freely and smoothly clockwise. Less than 25 kg-cm (22 in.-lb., 2.5 N·m) of torque should be required to rotate the clutch clockwise. If necessary, clean the converter and retest the clutch. Replace the converter if the clutch still fails the test.

Electrical Parts

1.  INSPECT SOLENOID

Check the resistance between the terminal and body.
Standard resistance:  11 — 15 Ω

2.  INSPECT NEUTRAL START SWITCH

Using an ohmmeter, check the continuity of the terminals for each switch position shown in the table below. If continuity between the terminals is not as specified, replace the switch.

Terminal
Range          B       N       C       R       2       L

P              ○       ○

R                              ○       ○

N              ○       ○

2                                              ○

L                                                      ○

3.  INSPECT SPEED SENSOR

Connect on ohmmeter to the speed sensor and check that the meter deflects when the sensor is repeatedly brought close to the rotor sensor magnet and removed from it.
